description: This PHP source file defines the class 'ProjectQuickCreate' which extends 'QuickCreate' to provide functionality for creating 'Project' records via a quick create form in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods to process form data, handle AJAX interactions, and generate necessary scripts and configurations for the UI.

classes.name: ProjectQuickCreate
classes.description: A class extending QuickCreate to manage quick creation of Project records, including rendering the form, handling AJAX calls, and setting up client-side scripts.
